Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:
1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Gunung Mas.

3. Bupati adalah Bupati Gunung Mas.
- 4 - 4 . Perangkat Daerah adalah unsur pembantu Bupati dan Dewan  Perwakilan Rakyat Daerah dalam penyelenggaraan urusan  pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenanga n Daerah.
5. Perlindungan Perempuan adalah segala upaya yang ditujukan  untuk melindungi perempuan dan memberikan rasa aman dalam  pemenuhan hak-haknya dengan memberikan perhatian yang  konsisten dan sistematis yang ditujukan untuk mencapru  kesetaraan gender.
6. Perlindungan Anal< adalah segala kegiatan untuk menjamin dan  melindungi Anak dan hak-haknya agar dapat hidup, tumbuh,  berkembang, dan berpartisipasi secara optimal sesuai dengan  harkat dan martabat kemanusiaan, serta mendapat perlindungan  dari Kekerasan dan diskriminasi.
7. Perempuan adalah sesorang yang berjenis kelamin perempuan.  8 . Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 (delapan belas)  tahun, termasuk anak yang masih dalam kandungan.
9 . Masyarakat adalah oran g perseorangan, kelompok Masyarakat,  termasuk di dalamnya orang tua dan keluarga.
10. Pencegahan adalah segala upaya untuk menghilangkan segala  resiko serta dampak buruk dari kekerasan terhadap Perempuan  dan Anak.
11. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan terhadap Anak yang berakibat  timbulnya kesengsaraan atau penderitaan secara fis.ik, psikis,  seksual, dan/ a tau penelantaran, termasuk ancaman untuk  melakukan perbuatan, pemaksaan, a tau perampasan  kemerdekaan secara melawan hu kum.
12. Forum Penanganan Korban Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan dan  Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat FPK2PA ad a lah forum koordinasi  penanganan korban Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan Anak  yang penyelenggaraannya secara berjenjang di tingkat kabupaten  dan kecamatan.
13. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Anak  yang selanjutnya disingkat P2TP2A adalah pusat pelayanan yang  terintegrasi dalam upaya pemberdayaan Perempuan di berbagai  bidang pembangunan, serta perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak  dari berbagai jenis diskriminasi, dan tindak Kekerasan, termasuk  perdagangan orang yang dibentuk oleh pemerintah atau berbasis  Masyarakat.
14. Kelurahan/Desa Ramah Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat K/DRA  adalah pem bangunan wilayah kelurahan/ desa yang menyatukan  komitmen dan sumber daya pemerintah kelurah an/desa yang  melibatkan Masyarakat dan dunia usaha yang berada di  kelurahan/ desa dalam rangka mempromosikan, melindu n gi, - 5 - memenuhi dan menghormati hak-hak anak, yang direncanakan  secara sadar dan berkelanjutan.

REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES
GUNUNG MAS REGENCY
REGENT OF GUNUNG MAS
REGIONAL REGULATION ON THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN.
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Gunung Mas Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent and regional apparatus as elements of regional government administration.
3. Regent is the Regent of Gunung Mas.
- 4 - 4. Regional Apparatus is the supporting element of the Regent and Regional House of Representatives in the administration of government affairs that are the authority of the Region.
5. Protection of Women is all efforts aimed at protecting women and providing a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights by providing consistent and systematic attention aimed at achieving gender equality.
6. Protection of Children is all activities to guarantee and protect Children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, as well as receive protection from Violence and discrimination.
7. Woman is a person who is female in gender.
8. Child is a person who has not yet reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years, including a child still in the womb.
9. Community is individuals, community groups, including parents and family.
10. Prevention is all efforts to eliminate all risks and adverse impacts of violence against Women and Children.
11. Violence is any act against a Child that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion, or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
12. Forum for Handling Victims of Violence Against Women and Children, hereinafter abbreviated as FPK2PA, is a coordination forum for handling victims of Violence against Women and Children whose implementation is tiered at the regency and sub-district levels.
13. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as P2TP2A, is an integrated service center in efforts to empower Women in various fields of development, as well as protection of Women and Children from various types of discrimination and acts of Violence, including trafficking in persons established by the government or community-based.
14. Child-Friendly Village/Sub-District, hereinafter abbreviated as K/DRA, is the development of a village/sub-district area that unites the commitment and resources of the village/sub-district government involving the Community and business world located in the village/sub-district in order to promote, protect, - 5 - fulfill and respect the rights of children, which is planned consciously and sustainably.

Article 14
(1) Prevention of violations against the rights of Children is implemented by the Regional Government and the Community.
(2) Prevention of violations against the rights of Children implemented by the Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented by:
a. forming work networks;
b. conducting coordination, integration, synchronization of Prevention based on partnership patterns with the Community, private sector, community self-reliance institutions; and
c. conducting socialization of laws and regulations related to Child Protection.
(3) Prevention of violations against the rights of Children implemented by the Community as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented by:
a. increasing the productivity of Children;
b. developing the self-potential of Children;
c. preventing pregnancy at a young age;
d. reducing maternal and infant mortality rates; and
e. preventing the occurrence of domestic violence.
(4) The formation of work networks as referred to in paragraph (2) letter a, includes work partners of the Regional Government in the implementation of Prevention of rights violations in the form of family partners.
(5) Further provisions regarding Prevention of violations against the rights of Children as referred to in paragraph (3) are regulated in the Regent Regulation.

Article 18

(4) Coordination forum as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be conducted periodically, at least 2 (two) times in 1 (one) year.

translated_text:
CHAPTER VII
GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION
Article 31
(1) The Regent is obligated to conduct guidance and supervision of the Protection of Women and Children.
(2) The implementation of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be carried out by Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.
- 17 - (3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training;
d. monitoring and evaluation; and
e. reporting.
(4) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is to realize the objectives of the Protection of Women and Children in accordance with standard norms, procedures and criteria implemented by Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection.
(5) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be conducted with professional and transparent principles.
(6) In implementing guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1), Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection must report periodically to the Regent.
(7) In the case of guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2), Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection may cooperate and coordinate with other Regional Apparatus, the Community, agencies and/or related institutional organizations.

EVALUATION
Article 32
(1) Evaluation of the Protection of Women and Children is conducted based on service implementation documents, empowerment, Prevention, fulfillment and monitoring results of the implementation of the Protection of Women and Children.
(2) The implementation of evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by the Regional Apparatus that administers governmental affairs in the field of empowerment of Women and Protection of Children.
(3) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) includes evaluation of process, impact and results.
(4) The results of evaluation as referred to in paragraph (3) constitute material for the Regional Apparatus to prepare a report which is subsequently submitted to the Regent.
(5) Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (4) is implemented at least 1 (one) time in 1 (one) year.

text:
PENJELASAN
ATAS
PERATURAN DAERAH KABUPATEN GUNUNG MAS
NOMOR 1 TAHUN 2021
TENTANG
PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK
I. UMUM
Anak adalah masa depan bangsa dan generasi penerus cita cita bangsa, sehingga setiap Anak berhak atas kelangsungan  hidup, tumbuh dan berkembang, berpartisipasi serta berhak atas  perlindungan dari tindak Kekerasan dan diskriminasi serta hak  sipil dan kebebasan.
Demikian pula Perempuan yang berperan sebagai ibu yang  melahirkan anak-anak yang sehat, kuat, tangguh, berakhlak  mulia, potensial dan berkualitas. Melalui peranan Perempuan  dalam keluarga, Masyarakat dan negara akan lahir generasi genarasi tangguh yang akan melanjutkan cita-cita bangsa.  Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun  1945 khususnya Pasal 27 ayat ( 1) yang menyatakan bahwa "Segala  warga negara bersamaan kedudukannya di dalam hukum dan  pemerintahan dan wajib menjunjung tinggi hukum dan  pemerintahan itu dengan tidak ada kecualinya". Walaupun  Undang-Undang Dasar Negara Republik Indonesia Tahun 1945  telah menjamin persamaan kedudukan di setiap warga negara,  namun hingga saat ini Perempuan dan Anak masih mengalami  berbagai hambatan untuk memperoleh hak-haknya hampir  di segala bidang.
Di sisi lain, Perempuan memiliki kebutuhan khusus  dibandingkan laki-laki, sehingga sesuai dengan kodratnya  tersebut, dalam kondisi tertentu Pemerintah Daerah harus dapat  menjamin haknya dipenuhi sesuai dengan kebutuhan tersebut.  Sedangkan anak, mereka adalah amanah dan karunia Tuhan Yang  Maha Esa, dimana dalam dirinya melekat harkat dan martabat  sebagai manusia seutuhnya. Mengingat posisi dan harapan kepada  anak sebagai potensi dan masa depan bangsa sehingga anak patut  mendapat perhatian dari semua pihak agar anak dapat tumbuh  dan berkembang secara wajar serta terhindar dari perlakuan dan  tindakan yang salah, Kekerasan, diskirminasi yang akan merusak  perkembangan anak baik fisik, mental maupun sosial anak. Untuk  itu anak perlu mendapatkan kesempatan seluas-luasnya untuk  dapat tumbuh dan berkembang secara optimal, baik secara fisik,  mental, sosial dan akhlak yang mulia.
- 21 - Berpangkal tolak dari hal tersebut, diperlukan suatu  regulasi yang menjadi pedoman bagi semua pihak, khususnya  Pemerintah Daerah dalam menjamin terselenggaranya  Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak di Kabupaten Gunung Mas  sesuai dengan kewenangan yang dimiliki yang tercantum dalam  Undang-Undang Nomor 23 Tahun 2014 tentang Pemerintahan  Daerah, maupun peraturan perundang-undangan lain yang  mengatur tentang Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak.
translated_text:
ELUCIDATION
OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF GUNUNG MAS REGENCY
NUMBER 1 OF 2021
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN
I. GENERAL
Children are the future of the nation and the next generation of the nation's aspirations, so that every Child has the right to survival, to grow and develop, to participate and has the right to protection from acts of Violence and discrimination as well as civil rights and freedoms.
Likewise Women who play a role as mothers who give birth to children who are healthy, strong, resilient, of noble character, potential and quality. Through the role of Women in the family, Society and the state, resilient generations will be born who will continue the nation's aspirations.
The 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia, specifically Article 27 paragraph (1) which states that "All citizens have equal status in law and government and are obliged to uphold the law and government without exception". Although the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia has guaranteed equal status for every citizen, until now Women and Children still experience various obstacles to obtaining their rights in almost all fields.
On the other hand, Women have special needs compared to men, so that in accordance with their nature, in certain conditions the Regional Government must be able to guarantee that their rights are fulfilled in accordance with those needs. Whereas children, they are a trust and gift from God Almighty, in whom is inherent dignity and worth as complete human beings. Considering the position and expectations of children as the potential and future of the nation, children deserve attention from all parties so that children can grow and develop naturally and avoid wrong treatment and actions, Violence, discrimination that will damage the development of children both physically, mentally and socially. For this reason, children need to get the widest possible opportunity to be able to grow and develop optimally, both physically, mentally, socially and with noble character.
- 21 - Based on this, a regulation is needed that serves as a guideline for all parties, especially the Regional Government in ensuring the implementation of Protection of Women and Children in Gunung Mas Regency in accordance with the authority possessed as stated in Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, as well as other laws and regulations that regulate the Protection of Women and Children.
